svg.title: Coastal Wind 35 — Interior Sections (Sheet 6 of 6)
svg.text: Longitudinal Section A–A (Centreline Cut) · Cross-Sections B–B to E–E · Scow-Bow Revolution 29 Derivation · Scale 1:20
SECTION A–A — LONGITUDINAL (CENTRELINE CUT, PORT SIDE VIEW)
Interior sole at DWL+400 mm · Seamless open plan: forward berth flows into saloon without any dividing wall
← SEAMLESS OPEN-PLAN ZONE: 4900 mm — NO DIVIDING WALL (Forward Berth ↔ Saloon) →
BERTH CUSHION 150mm (same sole level as saloon)
LOA = 9900 mm (scow bow — no forward overhang)
INTERIOR (anchor aft wall to cockpit fwd BH): 6900 mm
CROSS-SECTIONS (PORT HALF SHOWN · MIRROR FOR STARBOARD)
Scow bow produces much fuller forward sections · Same 1700 mm half-breadth reached at St2 (x=1800) instead of St5 (x=4500)
Wide scow section · 1700mm half-beam reached early
Chainplate BH · Mast compression post · Nav station (stbd)
Max beam · 1950mm headroom · Port+stbd settee berths · Keel stub below sole
Cockpit opening · Aft cabin (port) + Engine room (stbd) under side-decks
SCALE BAR (1:20 print · 62.5 mm on paper = 1250 mm real)
NOTE: All dims in mm. Section A–A is longitudinal CL cut (port side). Sections B–E are half-sections (port half; mirror for stbd). Scow bow (Revolution 29 derived): plumb stem,
no forward overhang, wide DWL entry (600mm HB at bow vs ~100mm conventional). Key design benefit: full interior width available by St2 (x=1800) — enables the wide forward berth.
Seamless saloon ↔ forward berth: sole at same level throughout (DWL+400mm), no dividing bulkhead from x=900 to x=5800 (4900mm open span). Heads at x=1800–2800 port, curtain-separated only.
Cross-section dimensions: Deck HB = half-breadth at deck edge. DWL HB = half-breadth at design waterline. Keel stub omitted from cross-sections B–E; see full_scale_lines_plan.svg for keel details.
